registryName: Meal Support Care Plan Context Registry

entries.label: Meal Support Baseline
entries.description: The person's usual mealtime presentation, eating pattern, and overall support needs during meals.

entries.label: Meal Assistance Level
entries.description: The expected hands-on or supervisory assistance level during meals or snack support.

entries.label: Meal Prompt Level
entries.description: The usual prompt intensity needed for safe eating, pacing, or meal participation.

entries.label: Diet Order or Meal Plan
entries.description: The prescribed diet order, meal plan, or nutrition restrictions that staff should follow.

entries.label: Aspiration Precautions
entries.description: Specific aspiration or choking precautions that apply during meals or drinks.

entries.label: Supervision During Meals
entries.description: The required supervision level or staff oversight expected during mealtime support.

entries.label: Meal Pacing Requirements
entries.description: Any required meal pacing instructions such as bite size, pauses, or staff cueing cadence.

entries.label: Safe Swallow Protocol
entries.description: Ordered safe-swallow steps or feeding procedures that staff should follow during meals.

entries.label: Fluid Intake Support
entries.description: Support required for offering, pacing, cueing, or monitoring fluids with meals.

entries.label: Intake Monitoring Requirements
entries.description: Any requirement to document portions, calories, supplements, or percentage of meal consumed.

entries.label: Adaptive Utensils or Equipment
entries.description: Adaptive utensils, cups, plates, seating, or meal equipment needed for safe eating.

entries.label: Positioning During Meals
entries.description: Required body positioning or seating setup before, during, or after meals.

entries.label: Food Texture Requirements
entries.description: Any texture modification requirements for food served during meal support.

entries.label: Liquid Consistency Requirements
entries.description: Any ordered liquid consistency such as thin, nectar, honey, or thickened liquids.

entries.label: Supplement or Special Nutrition Support
entries.description: Any prescribed supplements, special formulas, or nutrition supports that should be given or tracked.

entries.label: GERD or Reflux Precautions
entries.description: Any GERD, reflux, or post-meal positioning precautions tied to digestion and mealtime safety.

entries.label: Choking Risk Status
entries.description: The documented choking or aspiration risk level relevant to meal support.

entries.label: Blood Glucose Meal Monitoring
entries.description: Meal-related blood glucose checks, snack corrections, or diabetic monitoring steps tied to meals.

entries.label: Meal Refusal Pattern
entries.description: Known refusal patterns, triggers, or support approaches related to meals or intake.

entries.label: Meal Related Notification Threshold
entries.description: What intake, choking, glucose, vomiting, or refusal findings should trigger staff notification or escalation.
